llm.title: Glossary: LLM
llm.quote: These models are trained on vast amounts of text data and can generate human-like text

pretraining.title: Glossary: Pretraining
pretraining.quote: are pretrained to predict the next word, given the previous context of text in the document

pretrained.title: Glossary: Pretraining
pretrained.quote: These pretrained models are not inherently good at answering questions or following instructions, and often require deep skill in prompt engineering to elicit desired behaviors. Fine-tuning and RLHF are used to refine these pretrained models

tokens.title: Glossary: Tokens
tokens.quote: can correspond to words, subwords, characters, or even bytes

finetune.title: Glossary: Fine-tuning
finetune.quote: it has already been fine-tuned to be a helpful assistant

rag.title: Glossary: RAG (retrieval augmented generation)
rag.quote: This allows the model to access and use information beyond its training data

temperature.title: Glossary: Temperature
temperature.quote: Lower temperatures result in more conservative and deterministic outputs that stick to the most probable phrasing and answers

temperature-def.title: Glossary: Temperature
temperature-def.quote: Temperature is a parameter that controls the randomness of a model's predictions during text generation

temperature-zero.title: Glossary: Temperature
temperature-zero.quote: Even with temperature set to 0, the results will not be fully deterministic

reliable.title: Models overview: reliable knowledge cutoff
reliable.quote: Reliable knowledge cutoff Jun 2026 Jun 2026 Jun 2026 Feb 2025

websearch.title: Web search tool
websearch.quote: allowing it to answer questions with up-to-date information beyond its knowledge cutoff

halluc.title: Reduce hallucinations
halluc.quote: can sometimes generate text that is factually incorrect or inconsistent with the given context

halluc-docs.title: Reduce hallucinations: external knowledge restriction
halluc-docs.quote: Explicitly instruct Claude to only use information from provided documents and not its general knowledge

halluc-idk.title: Reduce hallucinations: allow Claude to say I don't know
halluc-idk.quote: Explicitly give Claude permission to admit uncertainty

halluc-limit.title: Reduce hallucinations
halluc-limit.quote: while these techniques significantly reduce hallucinations, they don't eliminate them entirely

halluc-validate.title: Reduce hallucinations
halluc-validate.quote: Always validate critical information, especially for high-stakes decisions

ftdef.title: Glossary: Fine-tuning
ftdef.quote: Fine-tuning is the process of further training a pretrained language model using additional data.
